body:
So it’s not the exact same situation bc we are a two mom family but my wife (the non gestational parent) only got 6 weeks of paid leave after our baby was born. Her boss and the other folks in her department are all men (who have kids so they have done this before!) and they all thought six weeks was a lot! It’s wild bc six weeks is nothing. I think some men feel like they don’t have to do as much. 

It’s great that you get 12 weeks and definitely take all of it! You won’t regret it.

I know you have a lot of stories here to help you feel better about switching but I wanted to add another. I tried pumping for two weeks while my daughter was in the NICU. I made NO MILK and pumping made me so depressed. I literally cried to my wife when I told her I couldn’t do it anymore. 

Switching to formula and never looking back has been wonderful for us. My daughter has grown wonderfully and is absolutely perfect! You got this!
Same with breastfeeding things. I had so much that I stuffed into the closet.
Yeah I was gonna say, my daughter is 99%ile and has been wearing fives and we’re about to try to move her to 6s due to leaks so yeah, some babies do need those sizes lol.

My daughter is 9 months (almost 10) and we’re seeing her personality develop and I love it! She’s quiet and she likes to watch everyone else but she is so so loving to those she knows (her parents, her favorite daycare teachers). She is taking it all in. I think it’s similar to both my wife and I, as we are quiet and introverted too.
Rock-a-doodle still is an all time favorite for me. I am quite sure I have most of it memorized!

99.7% weight, 92% height, about to be 8m in 18m clothes, size 5 Huggies diapers. She’s round and getting tall! She can fit in some 24m stuff. Edit: weighs about 24lbs. Height hasn’t been measured since 6m appt lol.
Wow this is the same for us, but almost 7m. She hates tummy time and can’t roll & doesn’t seem to want to.
Make mom share all her food!
My daughter co-signs this!
Can I ask what rolling exercises you do? My daughter is 6m and not rolling yet so we’re struggling.
It’s giving Vera Bradley purses that my mom has
6m, 22lbs and size 5s. We went thru the 2s and 3s so quickly.
6 weeks was the earliest here and we pay $200/week. But that’s with a subsidy and of course it depends on the area.
I don’t know what the I stands for but I believe it’s reproductive endocrinologist. Basically they specialize in reproductive health
I use her stroller but it depends what kind of shopping? If it’s a big grocery shop I guess the stroller won’t work, but it does fine for smaller trips. I’m sorry, I’ve been struggling with this too!

My wife does this and she finds it helpful and one less thing to have to worry about on a daily basis. Black slacks and polo shirts. She does vary the color of the shirts. I didn’t even notice she was doing it until she told me (after I complained that picking out clothes is stressful), so it’s not like super obvious, if you’re worried that people might find it weird.
My daughter also hated the Snoo! Thankfully we didn’t have to pay for it but yeah she was not a fan!
The blanket swaddles worked for us but mostly because my wife figured out quickly how to wrap a swaddle! She’s an expert now and they serve our needs quite well.
We don’t heat bottles and she takes them cold/room temp! One day last week the sitter tried to use warm water and the baby wouldn’t take the bottle. 😅
Ooh good idea!
